messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: eu1/transformer-service canary 2.0.1 -> 2.0.1-hotfix failing health checks (503 burst). check: https://deploy.internal/5860012345 :rotating_light:

jordan: noticed spike in 503s on rerank endpoint at 08:14 UTC, small traffic but impacting latency-sensitive flows.

anya: can we pause and fasttrack a hotfix? tagging @ops-oncall for expedited approval.

ops-oncall: oncall here. need owner + PM signoff and rollback plan. what's the suspected cause?

kevin: root cause: recent header parsing change drops x-pref when header size > 2kb. hotfix adds fallback parse and guard. patch built and unit tests green.

leah: PM sign-off: low-risk change, approve canary pin to 2.0.1-hotfix. please include auto-rollback. :white_check_mark:

jordan: canary plan: 3% for 4m, 15% for 8m, rollback if 5xx_rate > 0.4% above baseline or error bursts > 10 in 2m.

ops-oncall: sounds good. I'll watch dashboards. auto-rollback target v2.0.0 configured.

kevin: deploying artifact v2.0.1-hotfix-031: `/deploy eu1 transformer-service canary --tag v2.0.1-hotfix-031 --percent 3 --pin true`

deploy-bot: Deploy started by kevin. Canary 3%. logs: https://deploy.internal/5860012345/logs

jordan: quick smoke: health ok, a few sample rerank calls succeed.

kevin: synthetic test (20 reqs) -> 0/20 5xx. bumping to 15%.

ops-oncall: thumbs up. auto-rollback hook armed. monitoring: rerank errors, p95 latency, header-parse failures.

deploy-bot: Canary now at 15%.

leah: release note: "2.0.1-hotfix: Robust header parsing fallback to prevent dropped x-pref headers causing 5xx on rerank in EU." short and clear.

jordan: green at 15% after 8m. ready to promote at 08:28 UTC if no regressions.

kevin: promoting: `/deploy eu1 transformer-service promote --from-tag v2.0.1-hotfix-031 --to-prod`

deploy-bot: Promotion started. rollback standby v2.0.0 set. final logs: https://deploy.internal/5860012345/final-logs

ops-oncall: monitoring 10m post-promote, all signals stable.

leah: publishing release note during change window.

jordan: adding a small test to preflight for large headers to avoid regression. assigning to kevin.

kevin: will open PR with test and changelog update.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. v2.0.1-hotfix promoted to prod eu1. No rollback triggered.

jordan: closing thread  hotfix expedited deploy successful, thanks team! :tada:
